title: Byte-addressed memory
statement: Memory is a finite map from word-sized addresses to bytes. A multi-byte load reconstructs a word according to a declared byte order and may require alignment, access, and non-faulting preconditions. Stores update exactly the addressed bytes in the declared model.

formal.statement: Memory aw := Word aw -> Word 8; load_le n m a := sum_{i=0}^{n-1} m(a+i) * 2^(8i)

notes: This is the book's ordinary finite memory model, not a concurrency, cache, privilege, or virtual-memory model.
